title: Upgrade Data Access Layer
problem_statement: The application uses Microsoft Jet OLEDB provider, which is outdated and may have security vulnerabilities.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential security vulnerabilities and lack of support for newer data sources.
suggested_approach: Migrate to a more modern data access technology such as ADO.NET or Entity Framework.
success_criteria: All data access operations are performed using a modern and supported data access technology.
